If you’re looking to set up a new Microsoft SQL Server instance accessible at `http://plgah.ca`, here’s a quick outline of the typical steps you’d follow: | Step | What to Do | Typical Commands / Actions | |------|------------|---------------------------| | **1️⃣ Install SQL Server** | Deploy the SQL Server software on your host machine (`plgah.ca`). | • Windows: Use the installer (`setup.exe`)
• Linux/Unix: Run package manager install (`apt-get install mssql-server`), then run `sudo /opt/mssql/bin/sqlservr –s MSSQLSERVER`. | | **2️⃣ Configure Network Access** | Ensure port 1433 (default) is open and reachable over HTTP(S). server { listen 443 ssl; location /sqlsrv { proxy_pass tcp://127.0.0.1:1433; }
| | **3️⃣ Create Database & Users** | Set up the databases and login accounts needed for your applications. | ```sql CREATE DATABASE MyAppDB; GO
CREATE LOGIN myapp WITH PASSWORD='StrongPassword!'; GO
USE MyAppDB;
Create USER myapp FOR LOGIN myapp; GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE TO myapp;` | | **4️⃣ Secure Credentials** | Store connection strings securely—use Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or local encrypted files.
